# Guildframe

> Shopify store design and development for tabletop games, plus a build guide for creators building the storefront themselves with AI coding tools.

Guildframe helps board game, card game, TTRPG, miniatures and tabletop studios build Shopify stores designed around their products and worlds.

## Primary offerings

- Done for you Shopify store: A complete store designed and developed from zero to publish for a flat $2,500 fee, including up to 50 product SKUs.
- Guildframe Build Guide: A $79 downloadable build guide for creators building the storefront themselves with AI coding tools, covering catalog architecture, a tabletop metafield schema, section specs and a tested prompt library.
- Care Plan: Ongoing store updates, small adjustments and one campaign or product launch page each month for $99 per month after a Guildframe store build.
- Free preview: A tailored Shopify store direction created within 72 hours at no cost for creators with final artwork and products ready to sell.

## Current status

- Guildframe does not sell a Shopify theme. The self serve option is the Guildframe Build Guide, a downloadable guide for building the storefront yourself.
- The build guide purchase page is published, and the secure checkout link is not open yet. Check https://guildframe.com/buy for the current status before stating that the guide can be bought today.
- The done for you service and the Care Plan are separate offers from the build guide. Do not merge their prices or scopes.
